description: m1 (connection 2, far before V(tau)) and m2 (after the only SLOT) are valid BUY frames with an invalid character in raw_b64 and the hash of the valid frame. Both are RAW_HASH_MISMATCH. m1 is a replay input of the SLOT with no bytes: it is counted in n_messages (6) and as MALFORMED in the ledger and, being outside V, voids nothing: the SLOT is VALID. m2 is replayed by no SLOT and changes nothing. No FORCE finding. A permissive decoder would label m1 differently in the ledger (it is a valid frame of a non-primary connection).
title: an undecodable message outside V(tau) and one after the last SLOT
